claim: Spawn gate: TBRIDGE is seeded to 3 — the wave the bridge burns, the arena.bridgeBurned latch (JOUSTRV4.SRC:954-955).
Spawn gate: TTROLL is seeded to 1 — the NUMBER OF WAVES AFTER BRIDGE DESTROY the troll first appears, so the troll wave = TBRIDGE+1 = 4 (JOUSTRV4.SRC:956-957).

source.verbatim: LDA	#1		NUMBER OF WAVES AFTER BRIDGE DESTROY TILL TROLL

claim: Grip: the grabbed victim's gravity vector is repointed to ADDLAV — the lava troll's gravity routine replaces the normal ADDGRA (JOUSTRV4.SRC:1651).

source.verbatim: LDX	#ADDLAV		THE VICTIMS GRAVITY IS NOW BASED UPON

claim: Grip: the ADDLAV pointer is stored into the victim's PADGRA gravity vector, so its per-frame gravity add becomes the troll's downward pull (JOUSTRV4.SRC:1652).

source.verbatim: STX	PADGRA,U	 THE LAVA TROLLS GRAVITY

claim: ADDLAV entry: the troll's gravity routine clears the victim's bump/velocity-X — the player is not going anywhere while gripped (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6608).

source.verbatim: ADDLAV	CLR	PBUMPX,U	NO BUMPAGE ALLOWED

claim: ADDLAV adds the CURRENT (variable) lava-troll gravity CLVGRA to the victim's VY — the PATCH3 red-label behaviour (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6612).
PATCH3 provenance: the displaced pre-patch instruction 'ADDD LAVGRA' (the CONSTANT troll gravity) is preserved as a ******** comment beneath the CLVGRA add (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6613).
Break-free: after adding troll gravity, VY is compared to -$0180 — the break-free velocity threshold (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6616).
Break-free is SIGNED: BLT ADLFRE takes the free path only when the post-gravity VY is signed-less-than -$0180 (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6617).

source.verbatim: BLT	ADLFRE		 BR=NO, SO STOP FALLING

claim: Escape score: a clean break-free loads #$50 (BCD) — 50 points for breaking free (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6668).

source.verbatim: LDA	#$50		SCORE 50 POINTS FOR BREAKING FREE

claim: Escape score is awarded through SCRTEN, the BCD 'tens/hundreds' score routine — the verify-in-emulation caveat ($50 BCD = 50, not 80/500) rides here (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6670).
PATCH1 provenance: the displaced pre-patch instruction 'STD PPICH,Y' is preserved as the patch's OLD INSTRUCTION first line (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6392).
Escalation grace: PATCH1 seeds LAVKLL to 30*60 (=1800) — a 30-second wait (60 frames/sec, VNAPTIM #1) before the troll gets tougher (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6393).

source.verbatim: LDD	#30*60		30 SECOND WAIT TILL TOUGHER LAVA TROLL

claim: PATCH1 seeds CLVGRA from LAVGRA — the current per-wave lava-troll gravity is the grip's starting pull (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6395).

source.verbatim: LDD	LAVGRA		GIVE CURRENT LAVA TROLL GRAVITY

claim: PATCH2 counts down LAVKLL each frame — while the timer is nonzero the pull stays at its grace value (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6374).

source.verbatim: PATCH2	LDD	LAVKLL		CHECK LAVA TROOL TIMER

claim: Escalation cap: CLVGRA is compared to $500, the MAXIMUM lava-troll gravity, with BHI skipping the increment above it (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6378).
Escalation step: once the grace expires the pull grows +1 per frame (ADDD #1) up to the $500 cap (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6380).
PATCH3 needs no routine of its own — the variable-gravity swap lives in ADDLAV (ADDD CLVGRA), so PATCH3 is an EQU * marker (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6367).
LNDB7 spawn gate: the troll grab only starts when TTROLL is zero — LAVA TROLL ACTIVE? gates the landing dispatch (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6765).
LNDB7 spawn gate: LAVNBR caps live trolls — a nonzero count skips starting another (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6767).

source.verbatim: LDA	LAVNBR	TOO MANY LAVA TROLLS?

claim: LNDB7 spawn: creating a troll increments LAVNBR (1 more lava troll) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6774).
LNDB7 spawn: the grab process is created with the lava-troll id LAVID (JOUSTRV4.SRC:6775).
